qa_pairs.question: What is the maximum tightening torque for an M16 8.8 screw?
What torque specification applies to M16 10.9 screws?
What is the tightening torque for M16 12.9 grade screws?

What torque specification applies to M16x1.5 12.9 screws?

What is the difference in torque between M16 8.8 and M16 12.9 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: 140 Nm (340 Nm for M16 12.9 minus 200 Nm for M16 8.8)

qa_pairs.question: Are the torque values higher for standard M16 thread or M16x1.5 fine thread screws of the same grade?
qa_pairs.answer: Standard M16 thread screws have higher torque values than M16x1.5 fine thread screws of the same grade.
